# source of truth for these paths (leader decision 2026-10-01). The public copies stay only until
# ES.4 deletes them; a fix to any of them goes to the engine repo.

# Read by packages/server/scripts/frozen-paths-check.ts (the CI guard, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
# job `frozen-paths`) and by CLAUDE.md. One glob per line: `**` crosses directories, `*` stays
# inside one path segment. Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored.
#
# The ONE exception is the ES.4 deletion PR: a PR whose title carries `[ES.4]` and whose ONLY
# change to these paths is deletion passes. Anything else touching them fails.
#
# NOT frozen: packages/engine-api/** and the engine slot/host (packages/server/server/engine/**).
